statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let lam := fun x : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ block x, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n^2+1); ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ x : ℕ, B<x ∧ c*x ≤ lam x

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0069 · 在无界倍增窗中证明二次 Mangoldt 质量有线性下界
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0069 · Seek a linear lower bound for quadratic Mangoldt mass on unbounded windows

brief.zh: 这是额外的奇偶障碍。分析 u↦u²+1 上的素数权，需要超过线性进程 GRH 的输入。
brief.en: This is the parity-sensitive input. A lower bound on prime weights along u²+1 needs information beyond GRH in linear progressions.
